title: Grünfeld Defense: Exchange Variation
line: White gets a big center of pawns, and Black's bishop on the long diagonal attacks it.

steps.text: The Grünfeld, and White takes the pawn on d5. White wants to build a big center.
Trade the knight off. White's center grows, but Black is ready to attack it.
Put the bishop on the long diagonal. It aims at the pawns on d4 and c3, and at the rook behind them.
Strike at the center with the pawn on c7.
steps.after: White's rook steps off the bishop's line.

steps.text: Castle, to get your king to safety.
A mistake, not the usual move: here White pushed the pawn on d4 past, with the rook still at home.
Take the pawn on c3 with check. Your bishop now attacks the rook too.

steps.after: Black has a rook and a pawn for the bishop.

summary: White's center is big, and Black's bishop and side pawn aim at it. A center pawn that moves can open the bishop's line.
